name: Pi
what: A terminal coding agent that talks to any OpenAI-style or Ollama-style server named in its models.json, with an extension API.

update.note: npm view for the newest version, npm i -g <package>@<version> to move; the previous version is recorded and restorable. Setup writes pnpm-global instead when pnpm installed it.

all: Add your servers to ~/.pi/agent/models.json as providers with a baseUrl on 127.0.0.1.

good: agentic coding against the resident model
long sessions on a long-context engine
not: a model server of its own: it is a client, and the dashboard lists it as one
